# Cross-Validated MCP- or SCAD-penalized Classification Learner

MCP- or SCAD-penalized binary classification model with k-fold cross
validation for choosing the regularization parameter lambda. Calls
[`ncvreg::cv.ncvreg()`](https://pbreheny.github.io/ncvreg/reference/cv.ncvreg.html)
from package [ncvreg](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=ncvreg) with
`family` set to `"binomial"`. Covariates are internally standardized by
`ncvreg` prior to model fitting.

## Dictionary

This [Learner](https://mlr3.mlr-org.com/reference/Learner.html) can be
instantiated via
[lrn()](https://mlr3.mlr-org.com/reference/mlr_sugar.html):

    lrn("classif.cv_ncvreg")

## Meta Information

- Task type: “classif”

- Predict Types: “response”, “prob”

- Feature Types: “integer”, “numeric”

- Required Packages: [mlr3](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=mlr3),
  [mlr3extralearners](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=mlr3extralearners),
  [ncvreg](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=ncvreg)

## Parameters

|                |           |         |                  |                       |
|----------------|-----------|---------|------------------|-----------------------|
| Id             | Type      | Default | Levels           | Range                 |
| penalty        | character | MCP     | MCP, SCAD, lasso | \-                    |
| gamma          | numeric   | \-      |                  | \\\[0, \infty)\\      |
| alpha          | numeric   | 1       |                  | \\\[0, 1\]\\          |
| lambda.min     | numeric   | \-      |                  | \\\[0, \infty)\\      |
| nlambda        | integer   | 100     |                  | \\\[1, \infty)\\      |
| lambda         | untyped   | \-      |                  | \-                    |
| eps            | numeric   | 1e-04   |                  | \\(-\infty, \infty)\\ |
| max.iter       | integer   | 10000   |                  | \\\[1, \infty)\\      |
| convex         | logical   | TRUE    | TRUE, FALSE      | \-                    |
| dfmax          | integer   | \-      |                  | \\\[0, \infty)\\      |
| penalty.factor | untyped   | \-      |                  | \-                    |
| warn           | logical   | TRUE    | TRUE, FALSE      | \-                    |
| returnX        | logical   | TRUE    | TRUE, FALSE      | \-                    |
| cluster        | untyped   | \-      |                  | \-                    |
| nfolds         | integer   | 10      |                  | \\(-\infty, \infty)\\ |
| fold           | untyped   | \-      |                  | \-                    |
| returnY        | logical   | FALSE   | TRUE, FALSE      | \-                    |
| trace          | logical   | FALSE   | TRUE, FALSE      | \-                    |
| pred_lambda    | numeric   | \-      |                  | \\(-\infty, \infty)\\ |

## References

Breheny P, Huang J (2011). “Coordinate descent algorithms for nonconvex
penalized regression, with applications to biological feature
selection.” *Annals of Applied Statistics*, **5**(1), 232–253. ISSN
1932-6157. [doi:10.1214/10-AOAS388](https://doi.org/10.1214/10-AOAS388)
.

### `LearnerClassifNCVreg$new()`

Creates a new instance of this
[R6](https://r6.r-lib.org/reference/R6Class.html) class.

#### Usage

    LearnerClassifNCVreg$new()

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### `LearnerClassifNCVreg$selected_features()`

Returns the set of selected features which have non-zero coefficients.
Calls the internal `coef.cv.ncvreg()` function.

#### Usage

    LearnerClassifNCVreg$selected_features(lambda = NULL)

#### Arguments

- `lambda`:

  (`numeric(1)`)  
  Custom `lambda`, defaults to the lambda with the minimum CV error.

#### Returns

([`character()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/character.html)) vector of
feature names.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### `LearnerClassifNCVreg$clone()`

The objects of this class are cloneable with this method.

#### Usage

    LearnerClassifNCVreg$clone(deep = FALSE)

#### Arguments

- `deep`:

  Whether to make a deep clone.

## Examples

``` r
# Define the Learner
learner = lrn("classif.cv_ncvreg")
print(learner)
#> 
#> ── <LearnerClassifNCVreg> (classif.cv_ncvreg): MCP- or SCAD-penalized Classifica
#> • Model: -
#> • Parameters: list()
#> • Packages: mlr3, mlr3extralearners, and ncvreg
#> • Predict Types: [response] and prob
#> • Feature Types: integer and numeric
#> • Encapsulation: none (fallback: -)
#> • Properties: selected_features and twoclass
#> • Other settings: use_weights = 'error', predict_raw = 'FALSE'

# Define a Task
task = tsk("sonar")

# Create train and test set
ids = partition(task)

# Train the learner on the training ids
learner$train(task, row_ids = ids$train)
#> Warning: Maximum number of iterations reached

print(learner$model)
```
